name: Agent-Driven Pipeline
description: LLM-driven ingestion pipeline — an agent reviews incoming data, produces a transform plan, and optionally proposes sketch changes for human approval.

stages.name: Download

agentTier.rationale: Downloading is a straightforward fetch operation

processHints: Verify source connectivity before starting bulk downloads

stages.name: Agent Review
stages.description: LLM agent analyses raw data and current sketch to produce a transform plan. May propose sketch changes requiring human approval.

agentTier.rationale: Requires LLM reasoning about data-to-graph mapping

chunkGuidance.note: Default: sample first/last items. Set strategy to 'full' for thorough multi-call analysis.

processHints: Review the transform plan before proceeding to transform
Major sketch changes will pause the pipeline for human review
Minor sketch changes are auto-applied with logging

stages.name: Transform
stages.description: Execute the agent-produced transform plan to create graph nodes and edges. Falls back to LLM for items that do not match any mapping.

agentTier.rationale: Plan-driven transform with LLM fallback for unmapped items

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Group by node type per the transform plan

processHints: Apply node mappings first, then edge mappings
Collect unmatched items for a single LLM fallback call
Ensure deterministic IDs as specified in the plan

stages.name: Integrate
stages.description: Integrate transformed data into graph model

agentTier.rationale: Integration resolves conflicts and merges data

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Batch nodes by type; integrate sketch nodes before color

processHints: Always create a snapshot before integration
Resolve duplicate nodes by merging, not overwriting

stages.name: Verify
processHints: Report but do not auto-fix issues

stages.name: Report
processHints: Include transform plan summary in the report
Include sketch change decisions if applicable
